name: Box with Smoothed/Eroded Edges
definition: Computes a density value for a point inside a box, applying a sigmoid-based erosion at the boundaries and adding Perlin noise to roughen the surface.
summary: FunctionMakeBox converts SDF values to box density using sigmoid erosion for smooth edges and Perlin noise for surface roughness, differing from standard methods by combining axis-aligned falloffs with spatial noise.
